f2.default: We’re traders who teach the part most beginners skip: the plan, the stop and the size. Then we use it live, wins and losses included. No hype.

default.k2: To help you build a practical understanding of the markets: preparing a plan, managing risk and reviewing your decisions honestly.
Every live session and Telegram post explains the reasoning, so you learn a process instead of copying a number.
We follow a written plan, wait for our setups and skip trades that don’t fit. Fewer, better decisions.
